guesses.question: You say Glass Harbour came into your life in the winter of 2021, and that a friend put Second Lamp on the radio during a night shift that same winter. Did both records reach you in that one winter at the bakery, or is that not right?

quotes.quote: Glass Harbour came into my life in the winter of 2021, when I worked night shifts at a bakery in Leeds
put Second Lamp on the radio during a night shift that same winter
